name: scenario_anchors
layer_purpose_zh: 12 张 AI 场景卡的物理落点图层，与 assets/figures/scenario-locations.png、key-areas-zoom.png 的 P01—P12 标注同源。
layer_purpose_en: Placement layer for the 12 AI scenario cards, the same source used by the P01-P12 labels in assets/figures/scenario-locations.png and key-areas-zoom.png.
coordinate_reference_system: EPSG:4326 (geographic WGS84 / CGCS2000 lat-lon, consistent with the other geometry layers)

properties.carrier_zh: 原点社区西侧知识公园界面
properties.note_zh: 落点为方案设定的代表点，用于检验场景与空间的可对应性；不是选址批准，不含用地权属，须经现场踏勘与属地确认后方可作为实施依据。
properties.note_en: Representative placement set by the design to test that each scenario has a spatial counterpart; not an approved site selection, carries no land rights, and requires field survey and local confirmation before use for implementation.
